name: tamulib-dc-labs/archipelago-twig-lint
description: Offline parity check for Archipelago MetadataDisplayEntity::validateSource()

pinning_note: IDEALLY twig/twig would be pinned to exactly what the deployed Archipelago runs, because
linting with a NEWER Twig is a false-pass risk: Twig 3.x keeps adding filters, so a template
using one added in 3.20 lints clean here and is still rejected by a site on 3.14.
We do NOT pin low, because every 3.14.x release is blocked by composer security advisories.
Residual risk is small: these templates use long-established idioms and the whole 3.x line
Confirm the deployed version with: docker exec esmero-php composer show twig/twig
